regions.name: Gulf Coast
regions.blurb: Texas, Louisiana and the Mississippi coast: half of all American refining in one stretch of shoreline.

regions.name: Midwest
regions.blurb: Inland plants fed by pipeline from the Bakken, Canada and the Gulf. They fuel the farm belt and the Great Lakes cities.

regions.name: East Coast
regions.blurb: The Delaware River and New Jersey plants that supply the Northeast corridor.

regions.name: Rocky Mountains
regions.blurb: Small, high-altitude refineries that run local crude for the mountain states.

regions.name: West Coast
regions.blurb: California, Puget Sound, Hawaii and Alaska: an island market with its own clean-fuel specs.
